decisions.reason: task failure under visual token pruning is hard to predict per query and pruning conditions | sufficiency probability from uniformly sampled subsets jointly preserving answer, likelihood and output distribution; failure-prediction AUC +0.1151/+0.0683/+0.1401 for FastV/VisionZip/SparseVLM on LLaVA with log-loss and Brier reductions, reproduced on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL2-8B

monolithic self-correction rewrites whole designs, confusing errors and corrupting correct RTL | decompose-then-correct agentic framework with structure-oriented decomposition, snippet-based RAG and SVA-based self-correction plus ScaleBench; Pass@1 20.5%->49.0% on ScaleBench, up to 96.1% on VerilogEval; domain code-generation system without cross-task self-evolution

published speculative-decoding acceptance gaps shrink under shared training and inference conditions | comparison protocol remeasuring released checkpoints and retraining six drafter recipes on shared target-generated data across ten benchmarks and two targets; payoff conditional on task uncertainty and serving conditions; measurement-methodology study, no output-corruption or precision claim

compiling draft and target models individually leaves their shared speculative-decoding execution outside the optimization boundary | conjugate co-compilation with interleaved operand layouts preserving mathematics plus self-improving agentic plan search with MCTS over compiler and GPU feedback; 1.37x geomean per-round speedup (up to 1.59x) across six single-GPU configs on B300/RTX 5090, GPU utilization +1.46-1.50x

language confusion traceable to individual attention heads | single-head ablation across 12 checkpoints spanning seven series with FLORES-200 continuations and LCB replies; seven heads move 8.0-51.5% of continuations out of the prompt language vs at most 1.4% for other same-layer heads, head-output replacement with another language's mean redirects 84-99% of monolingual replies

distillation overshoot: a weaker student surpasses its teacher during on-policy distillation then regresses as erosion of successful student choices overtakes repair | Success-Preserving OPD masks conflicting teacher supervision on successful choices and adds a soft probability floor; up to +15.2pp over ordinary OPD and +20.0pp over the teacher, final checkpoints beat OPD's best intermediate checkpoints in all six settings

NVFP4 GEMM acceleration of frozen projections risks LoRA fine-tuning accuracy and activation memory | PACT reuses quantized RMSNorm outputs, saves gate/up activations in NVFP4, preserves BF16 inputs for forward nonlinearities and calibrates frozen weights offline with GPTQ adapted to NVFP4 scales; multiple models and tasks on a 16GB RTX 5080 at lower memory and faster fine-tuning with competitive accuracy

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: two same-job agent skills loaded together silently take over and drop the other skill's rules | SkillClash: 16 coded skill pairs with per-rule checking and reference outputs, seven models from 4B open to GPT-4.1; rules followed 93-99% alone vs 61-62% co-loaded, takeover driven by worked examples, shared-example files cut takeover to 1-15%, merged one-file fix reaches 96-99%

primary-metric objectives guide autonomous agents toward medically unsafe models | 15 real-world tasks from 10 clinical datasets with external validation across cohorts, hospitals and time periods; AIDE, AI Scientist v2, Codex and Autoresearch achieve competitive primary scores but worse calibration than simple baselines; domain agent benchmark excluded by the area's gate rule

brain-body mismatch: an evolving harness demands behaviors its model has not learned or restricts capabilities it already has | CoEvo-RSI coordinates harness development from a shared evolutionary archive with model checkpoint selection/merging and adaptation under the selected harness via SFT on rejection-sampled trajectories; Qwen3.5-9B beats DeepSeek-V4-Pro +14.16 on TraceElephant and GLM-5.3 +4.90 on HomeBench VM

a candidate's overall outcome alone does not reveal which design decisions produced their effects or should be retained | DAGLoop translates each decision's rationale into a testable expectation with a targeted ablation, builds a dependency DAG, and records structured research memory; substantial performance improvements across dozens of executable research tasks

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: discovery agents misallocate measurements between exploring new candidates and confirming promising ones under noise | Wellocate simulated assay campaigns on a generated landscape and scrambled GB1/PhoQ proteins with five minimal LLM agents and scripted baselines; three over-confirm and run short of new candidates, one under-confirms, every model ends worse than a basic scripted strategy on the generated landscape, untried-candidate lists help

new embodied manipulation capability costs demonstrations per task or a frontier model in every episode | skill-level recursive self-improvement: an offline author writes, runs, diagnoses and repairs skills against hidden-layout exams with a tamper-evident ledger; 4 of 7 RoboTwin tasks compiled at 4.29-8.22 USD author cost, repair-inheritance beats rewriting in 8/8 campaigns (p=0.004), frozen skills keep 148/150 successes with no model at ~0.0003-0.0005 USD per episode

memory value misestimated by historical retrieval success rates that ignore context dependency and evidence reliability | BEAM represents memory value as a context-conditioned dynamic Bayesian belief calibrated by execution feedback with merge and conflict resolution; consistent improvements in memory utilization and continual self-evolution on reasoning and code benchmarks

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: verdicts true when written silently fail when upstream support (e.g. a revoked signing key) fails, driving unsafe publications | Tether records the exact versions each verdict derives from at write time and withdraws any verdict whose support failed; Fallout versioned-world generator: atomic-fact memory publishes 62% of upstream-failing objects vs Tether 0.3% with 37% fewer verification calls (A-Mem/Graphiti 9%, Mem0 42%)

free-riding among co-retrieved skills and task difficulty confounding prevent identifying each skill's true contribution as the policy evolves | TrackRL turns grouped sampling into online randomized controlled experiments with reliability-weighted aggregation and an evidence-gated state-transition lifecycle from admission to removal; outperforms skill-augmented RL baselines in both library-assisted and skill-free evaluation

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: memory processing concentrates response distributions, narrowing the information available to users | MemBubble: 1000 instances built on preferences from real user-assistant conversations with test queries outside preference scenarios; entropy decreases 34.7% on average vs directly providing the full interaction history across multiple LLMs and memory mechanisms, user-side interventions do not close the gap

wiring choice, symmetry departure and reconfiguration of programmable OCS inter-pod interconnect | information-geometric framework (KL-regularized wiring distributions, smoothed critical-path cost, entropic proximal-gradient, GLR-CUSUM traffic change detection) with O(sqrt(Gamma*C*V1*T)) switching regret; validated on pipeline, data and MoE workloads vs integer programming

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: persistent-memory state validity and query-time influence remain ungoverned, letting ineligible memory causally leak into answers | PLACE factorized governance layer adding write-side state certification and read-side authorization on Mem0 with Qwen2.5-3B/7B factorial ablation; write governance improves lifecycle state correctness, read governance eliminates measured causal leakage, combination strongest while preserving support

first-exit prediction for momentum SGD depends on sampling information that pointwise gradient laws omit | reshuffled-exit separations, an O(h) mean-exit comparison with a finite-rate switching process, rounding-certified brackets on 32 ridge-logistic runs and exact-real certificates on ResNet-18/ViT checkpoints; pure optimization theory, no training-run monitoring or anomaly claim

fixed pipelines and reward-driven search underdetermine intervention choice in EEG analysis and decoding | NeuroAct dual-loop autonomous research across foundation models, predictors and combinations with research/development/review roles and outer-loop conditional testable recommendations; +17.75 over BrainAgent, +7.34 BA for EEGPT, experience reuse raises BCIC-IV-2a 34.66->50.81 with 64% fewer tokens

budgeted annotation and training-subset selection from large unlabeled pools | progressive candidate expansion driven by a hidden-state proxy plus exact cartography pruning by training dynamics; top average accuracy in medical/legal/financial domains annotating 20-30% and training on 10-15%; data-selection efficiency method, not representation analysis

VLM failures on human-simple tasks traced to persistent vision-language representational misalignment | linear unalignability of existing vision and language representations plus a predictably induced generalization failure and failure-mode correlation across backbones; more aligned backbones exhibit fewer failures, evidence against a strong Platonic Representation Hypothesis

how many effective variables survive coarse-graining of AlphaEarth land-pixel embeddings | beta-VAE rank-distortion envelopes with a two-control surface over tolerance and spatial scale; effective count falls 24->7 from 10m to 78.9km at 3% tolerance vs PCA 46->38; geospatial embedding latent structure, not LLM hidden states

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: trajectory-level outcome rewards give limited supervision for long-horizon deep search agents | EG-GRPO derives step-level process rewards from the first supporting citation of each required evidence claim and combines state-conditioned relative advantage with the trajectory outcome; outperforms standard GRPO and reward-enhanced/step-level baselines on five deep search benchmarks across model scales

high-impact unexplored concept pairs are hard to identify before the community connects them | scientific concept graphs from CIKM/KDD/SIGIR papers with a feature-designer agent and three LLM agents computing features from enclosing subgraphs, then a classifier-designer agent; outperforms impact-forecasting and temporal link-prediction baselines including emerging-concept settings

JEPA latent worlds lack a human-interpretable interface for prediction, planning and control | four-stage Ground/Structure/Verify/Act research agenda arguing interpretability must cover how latent variables interact and causally drive prediction; perspective without evaluation and not about LLM hidden states

how transformers recognize their own planning errors | path-finding abstraction with an abort token: O(|V|)-width feed-forward construction with near-optimal lower bound; in trained models invalid-transition detection increases previous-node attention with valid-invalid separation located in FFN outputs, and abort+retry improves reliability on graphs, Countdown and mazes

what production-scale hash-addressed conditional memory writes actually deposit | coverage/synergy/distortion audit on 124M-7B beds including a 176.95B FP8 model; writes are independently retrievable, addressable, reversible atoms that do not compose into reasoning (two-hop 26% vs 25% independent baseline); behavioral memory-injection audit matching no listed area problem

failures over rapidly evolving knowledge cannot be attributed to retrieval vs reasoning stages | TREKTRACE stage-attribution framework plus TREKBENCH-WILD real-world questions and TREKBENCH-CTRL controlled distractors; the main bottleneck is post-retrieval reasoning misled by conflicting evidence despite complete retrieval, and outdated-distractor benchmarks underestimate difficulty

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: unanimous GRPO groups carry zero within-group variance and zero advantage, so uniform sampling wastes rollouts on prompts that stay unanimous | Aperture estimates later pass rates from a short probe and weights prompts by the probability a training-size group splits; 1.7B/4B math and logic: improves greedy accuracy over uniform GRPO, raises the nonzero-advantage group fraction, stacks with dynamic sampling

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: all-correct and all-incorrect web groups spend their searches and page fetches for a zero advantage and push Gaussian curricula off course | RIDGE keeps Beta posteriors per prompt, weights by the marginal of a Gaussian target under the posterior divided by predicted tool-call cost, and centers on groups that just came back mixed; +3.4/+2.9 average accuracy over GRPO at 29.6% fewer math rollouts and 32.7% fewer tool calls than dynamic sampling

how multi-head attention expressivity depends on the number of heads | exact linear-fractional normal form for head complexity, threshold-degree lower bound and a symmetric-function characterization with an explicit strict-bound function; conjectures, proofs and Lean formalization produced by a frontier model with humans asking high-level questions

teacher takeover in on-policy distillation produces incorrect responses even when student and teacher each answer the same problem correctly | Contextual Digest structures earlier teacher guidance via a dependency graph with online meta-reweighting toward student-only improvement; +1.32-7.05pp over representative OPD methods on eight benchmarks, collaboration failure rate reduced 27.4-56.4%

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: derived memory state silently becomes outdated and wrong answers cannot be traced to the missed intermediate state | MemDerive specifies scenarios symbolically with Datalog-derived gold derivation DAGs over 4,692 events and 1,503 queries; all four memory systems fall behind simple BM25 on derived state while the same answer model reaches 96.01% given supporting events, failures mostly ungathered, implicit changes rarely propagated

agents reshape the logs, traces, corpora and evaluation records later used for training (endogenous drift), and marginal per-surface monitoring cannot identify cross-surface causes | falsifiable non-identifiability claim plus a four-problem research agenda (drift fusion, evolving traces, knowledge fabrics, shared evaluation gates); vision/position paper without evaluation

uniform per-layer KV-cache budgets ignore that layers differ in which tokens they need | multi-objective NAS learning per-layer budgets for any eviction method; beats uniform allocation in 146 of 154 settings (up to +48 RULER, +11.9 LongBench), 4x smaller cache at matched score; memory win with quality preservation, no precision-failure angle

static rubric criteria lose discrimination as RL learning progresses unevenly across requirements | RARE uses current policy feedback to decide both which criteria change and what replacements assess, swapping only fully-satisfied criteria; +3.82 mean over matched static rubrics across three video types with model and human preference support, extends to writing benchmarks

compressed medical segmentation models can keep Dice while silently changing the uncertainty signals that flag unreliable predictions | score-guided aggregate-validated mixed precision ranks quantization actions by benefit-risk and accepts only after full-model reliability validation on a calibration set; FP32-level Dice and uncertainty-map agreement at 3.59-7.82x compression across five 2D backbones and three 3D benchmarks

whether reasoning-correctness information is linearly decodable in a causally useful direction | 3M-parameter ChainSearch (Countdown with search and backtracking) searched with linear probes, mean activation differences and direct optimization plus causal interventions; statistically significant correctness directions exist but none consistently improves reasoning, questioning the linear representation hypothesis

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: VQA-style alignment leaves text representations non-visual (weak but not strong multimodality) | paired equivalent text/image shape-counting tasks on instruction-tuned vs vision-aligned Qwen-2.5 and Mistral; no text-variant gain despite strong image performance, probing corroborates no extra visual structure, in-context visual-embedding distillation induces text-task gains

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: Java LLM integration frameworks mishandle failing providers, including delivering a stream that ended without its terminator as a complete answer | six-clause reliability contract measured with a scripted OpenAI-compatible provider (15 failure scenarios, sync and streaming, 3 reps): Spring AI 72/77, LangChain4j 47/77 with defaults; a shared HTTP-boundary layer makes all three clients meet the contract in 90/91 cases at 32-217us median overhead

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: language-specific features claimed to be represented mainly in initial and final layers | fine-grained Portuguese/Spanish representation analyses plus 200+-language identification on Llama 3.2 1B; language identity remains strongly recoverable throughout the model, contextual-embedding manipulation shows a Spanish skew on ambiguous strings differing from human judgments

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: lossy context compaction replaces history with summaries and can silently help or hurt depending on when it triggers | Bud ContextCompact 2.0 evaluated on recorded sessions (1.2B recall 0.176 full-history -> 0.335 compacted, 9B 0.515->0.577) and 556 SWE-bench Verified sessions (long-session resolve 41%->53%, McNemar p=0.043, 13% fewer tokens per solve); gain vanishes under a 45-minute budget with 161s median summaries

fixed test-time sampling budgets ignore query difficulty and live GPU energy cost (up to 4.1x energy increase for one query under contention) | ATEST-Online incrementally samples, estimates plurality stability, monitors live GPU conditions and learns step energy cost to decide when to stop; four A100 datasets with no deferrals at 60.0% GSM8K under high load vs 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for the calibrated mode, transfers to L40S and Qwen2.5-3B

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: coding agents keep burning compute on runs that will fail verification | StopLoss fine-tunes a small window-scoring monitor on completed SWE-rebench trajectories labeled by verifier outcomes, with a threshold calibrated on successful runs; 4.5% lower cost per retained solve on Verified (99% of successes preserved) and up to 31-48% on Pro subsets, 1-2 orders of magnitude cheaper per check than six judges

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: hidden label shortcuts in serialized tool results masquerade as scientific reasoning | two-stage audit: per-tool TF-IDF decomposition localizes label-predictive patterns to individual tool results, then counterfactual token-class redaction tests dependence; on TCR-pMHC binding, tool augmentation beats the no-evidence baseline at face value but redacting identifiers reduces performance to chance

agent tool calls violate environment dependencies beyond predefined safety policies | constraints mined from API documentation, refined against execution traces, checked by an SMT solver at runtime with warning or uniquely-determined automatic repair; AppWorld detection F1 37.0->58.3 (GPT-5.5 traces) and 39.3->61.9 (Qwen3.5-27B), task success +5.4-9.8pp, 59-87% failed calls removed, transfers to tau2-bench

coordinating planning, execution and review so the result addresses the original objective | planner/worker/reviewer harness with reusable refined domain instructions; Terminal-Bench 2.1 93.26%, HealthBench Professional 69.63, +19.89 aggregate over direct completion at 7x mean cost; harness capability report without a silent pipeline-failure claim

factuality directions rotate away from each other across layers between lying and honest conditions | layer-wise direction extraction with a visual-perspective replication and single-trial trajectory analysis; rotation marks conceptual-space manipulation generally, trajectories strongly predict target task and behavior, divergence points match rotation onset, effects persist in naturalistic false reporting

rounding error obscures the small joint-vs-separate differences of vision-language intervention families | Finite Interaction Lens projects single-intervention components at higher precision and reuses them across joint candidates with a local cancellation identity and conditional error-propagation bound; interaction MSE -94.4% on 16 synthetic families and -99.85%/-99.35% on two COCO studies in one Qwen3-VL-4B MLP vs a same-budget BF16 control
